SELECT id, category, title, embedding::text, content_hash, scope, metadata, created_at, updated_at
FROM context_blocks
WHERE NOT is_archived
  AND (metadata->>'guard_checked_at') IS NULL
  AND category != 'index'
  AND embedding IS NOT NULL
  AND (block_type IS NULL OR block_type IN ('knowledge', 'source'))
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 100
UPDATE context_guard_state SET dirty_since = NULL, pending_count = 0, last_guard_at = now()

SELECT
    id,
    title,
    category,
    scope,
    LEFT(content, 300) AS preview,
    round(
        (1 - (embedding::halfvec(1024) <=> '{{ $json.embedding }}'::halfvec(1024)))::numeric,
        4
    ) AS similarity,
    CASE
        WHEN scope = '{{ $json.scope }}' OR scope = 'shared'
        THEN true
        ELSE false
    END AS same_scope
FROM context_blocks
WHERE id != '{{ $json.id }}'
  AND NOT is_archived
  AND embedding IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY embedding::halfvec(1024) <=> '{{ $json.embedding }}'::halfvec(1024)
LIMIT 3

UPDATE context_blocks SET 
  is_archived = true,
  metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'guard_status', '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.decision }}',
    'guard_checked_at', '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.checkedAt }}',
    'guard_similarity', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.topSimilarity }},
    'guard_matched_id', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.matchedBlockId ? "'" + $json.matchedBlockId + "'" : "''" }},
    'guard_is_cross_scope', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.isCrossScope || false }}
  )
WHERE id = '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.blockId }}'

UPDATE context_blocks SET guard_status = '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.decision }}',
  metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'guard_status', '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.decision }}',
    'guard_checked_at', '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.checkedAt }}',
    'guard_similarity', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.topSimilarity }},
    'guard_matched_id', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.matchedBlockId ? "'" + $json.matchedBlockId + "'" : "''" }},
    'guard_is_cross_scope', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.isCrossScope || false }},
    'guard_is_temporal', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.isTemporal || false }},
    'guard_threshold_duplicate', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.thresholds.duplicate }},
    'guard_threshold_review', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.thresholds.review }}
  )
WHERE id = '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.blockId }}'

INSERT INTO context_write_log (block_id, matched_block_id, decision, similarity, scope, block_title, block_category, metadata)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.blockId }}'::uuid,
  {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.matchedBlockId ? "'" + $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.matchedBlockId + "'::uuid" : "NULL" }},
  '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.decision }}',
  {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.topSimilarity }},
  '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.blockScope }}',
  '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.blockTitle }}',
  '{{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.blockCategory }}',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'is_temporal', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.isTemporal || false }},
    'threshold_duplicate', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.thresholds.duplicate }},
    'threshold_review', {{ $('Evaluate Guard').item.json.thresholds.review }}
  )
)

UPDATE context_guard_state SET
  last_guard_at = now(),
  dirty_since = CASE
    WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM context_blocks
          WHERE NOT is_archived
            AND (metadata->>'guard_checked_at') IS NULL
            AND category != 'index'
            AND embedding IS NOT NULL
            AND (block_type IS NULL OR block_type IN ('knowledge', 'source'))
         ) = 0
    THEN NULL
    ELSE dirty_since
  END,
  pending_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM context_blocks
    WHERE NOT is_archived
      AND (metadata->>'guard_checked_at') IS NULL
      AND category != 'index'
      AND embedding IS NOT NULL
      AND (block_type IS NULL OR block_type IN ('knowledge', 'source'))
  )
SELECT decision, count(*) as cnt FROM context_write_log WHERE created_at > now() - interval '2 minutes' AND decision != 'clean' GROUP BY decision
